entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Sri Deepak Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and
perused the record.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him
on bail in Case Crime No. 148 of 2024, registered under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. & Section 3/4 of
Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mandawar, District Bijnor during pendency of the trial.

entities.text: Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mandawar, District Bijnor
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. As per as Fir, deceased was married with applicant's elder brother.
After marriage, in-laws were used to harass and torture the deceased for want of dowry.
On 28.04.2024, they committed dowry death of informant's daughter.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.

Applicant is Pawan vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140739239/
1 brother-in-law of the deceased.
Cause of death is Asphyxia ante-mortem hanging.
Allegation in the FIR for demand of dowry is false and baseless.
There is no specific role against the applicant.

Co-accused, namely, Kamlesh, who is mother-in-law of the deceased, has been granted bail by this Hon'ble Court vide order dated 31.08.2024 and the applicant's case is similar to the co-accused,
hence, applicant is also entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of same footing.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 30.04.2024.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Pawan, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 12.11.2024 Nitin Verma  Pawan vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140739239/
